info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Human Resources Direction API
info.description: The Human Resources Direction API facilitates the management of human resources directives within the banking sector. This API allows organizations to streamline HR processes by enabling the creation and updating of HR directives. It serves HR professionals and systems integrating HR management functionalities, enhancing decision-making and operational efficiency. Common use cases include establishing policies, managing employee relations, and aligning HR operations with organizational goals.

post.summary: Create a new human resources direction.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new human resources direction entry in the system. Provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully create the entry.
